verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a single community report that Ollama has shipped ROCm containers since 0.1.27, which suggests a first-party container image exists for running the runtime. Nothing in the pack documents container usage, image names, configuration, GPU passthrough, or reproducible deployment workflows. Missing for 10: first-party Docker/container documentation, official image references, deployment and configuration guidance, broader hands-on corroboration beyond one comment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the runtime inside a container for reproducible deployment

citations.quote: They have shipped ROCm containers since 0.1.27.
